title: Poetry in RAGs: Modern Greek interwar poetry generation using RAG and contrastive training

live_model.evidence: "In total we had 8 poet/theme pairs using GPT4-turbo with two poems each for base, RAG-assisted, and RAG-assisted contrastive generation (total of 48 poems)"

prompt.location: Sec. on RAG architecture (Fig. 1): prompt structure described ("enhanced prompt structure that explicitly guides the LLM to follow the stylistic patterns...while avoiding...contrasting examples")
prompt.note: Prompt construction is described narratively; no appendix with the literal prompt template text was found.

claim.metric: inter-annotator Spearman correlation among 3 expert evaluators rating GPT-4-turbo generated poems (style/theme/versification/creativity)
claim.location: Sec. 5 ("moderate agreement...Spearman correlation (approx. 0.4)"); Fig. 2 gives per-condition standard/relativized correlation bars for GPT-4 Turbo (3 evaluators)

data.source: Modern Greek interwar poetry corpus (target/contrastive poets); exact release status of the corpus and generated poems not stated

notes: 48 poems (8 poet/theme pairs x 2 poems x 3 generation conditions) is a clear n, and GPT-4-turbo's role as the generator is unambiguous, but the paper's main reported numbers are inter-evaluator agreement coefficients rather than a direct poem-quality score, and the prompt is only described, not quoted verbatim.
